article.title: Trump lifts sanctions on top Al Qaeda recruiters, financiers days before 9/11 anniversary
article.author: Max Blumenthal
article.content: As the U.S. prepares to mark 25 years since Sept. 11, 2001, Donald Trump has removed top Al Qaeda figures from the U.S. list of designated terrorists. Among those he delisted was Abdullah Muhaysini, a Saudi cleric who recruited child fighters and teen suicide bombers to wreak havoc across Syria. The post Trump lifts sanctions on top Al Qaeda recruiters, financiers days before 9/11 anniversary appeared first on MR Online .
